name: Aramis Hammerhand
summary: Aramis Hammerhand is an undead holy warrior situated within the desecrated chapel of Deathknell. As a Forsaken paladin trainer, he instructs newly risen dead who seek to reclaim their bond with the Holy Light. Walking this path in undeath requires immense discipline, as wielding such radiant energy inflicts agonizing pain upon their decayed flesh.

sections.title: A Beacon in Deathknell
sections.body: Standing within the somber walls of Deathknell's chapel, Aramis Hammerhand represents an anomaly among the recently awakened Forsaken. In life, many citizens of Lordaeron answered the call of the Silver Hand, only to perish when the Scourge swept across the north. Aramis survived the fall only to be raised into undeath, yet he chose not to abandon the martial and spiritual teachings of his former existence. Now, he offers guidance to others who refuse to surrender their devotion.

sections.title: The Agony of the Holy Light
sections.body: For an undead being, channeling the Holy Light is an ordeal of supreme willpower. The power burns necrotic flesh and reawakens long-dead nerves to excruciating pain. Aramis instructs his initiates that holding to this faith requires enduring continual torment. Through tasks like 'A Difficult Path' and 'Rediscovering the Light', he demands that young paladins confront the physical and spiritual costs of wielding a force inherently opposed to their present nature.

faq.answer: Aramis Hammerhand is a Forsaken paladin trainer located inside the chapel at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. He assists newly risen undead who wish to pursue the path of holy combat.

faq.q: Can the Forsaken actually wield the Holy Light?
faq.answer: Yes, through sheer willpower and conviction, Forsaken can call upon the Holy Light. However, doing so causes immense physical agony, as the radiant energy burns and scours their rotting flesh while healing or bolstering them.

faq.q: Where can I find Aramis Hammerhand?
faq.answer: He can be found standing inside the chapel of Deathknell, the introductory settlement for the Forsaken in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What quests does Aramis Hammerhand offer?
faq.answer: Aramis offers several class-specific quests for newly risen paladins, including 'A Difficult Path', 'Rediscovering the Light', 'A Light in the Darkness', 'Coming to Terms', and 'Continue Your Training'.

faq.q: Why is a paladin trainer working for the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Before the plague, Lordaeron was the cradle of the Knights of the Silver Hand. Many of the newly liberated Forsaken remember their oaths and refuse to abandon their sacred calling, regardless of their undead state.

faq.q: Does using the Light heal the undead in the normal way?
faq.answer: While the Light can mend their bodies and grant them martial strength, the process is excruciating. It reignites their sensory nervous systems, forcing them to feel the rot of their own bodies.

angles.text: For Forsaken paladins, Aramis is the first mentor they meet, guiding them through the agony and spiritual discipline required to wield the Holy Light in an undead vessel.
Aramis demonstrates that rising into undeath does not require abandoning Lordaeron's proud heritage of holy warfare, even if it comes with immense personal suffering.
